about: Where the Heading Mark is painted, as an inline style (ADR-0008, 2026-10-13, ADR-0053): one rectangle per run of marked Headings, a column's in the header band's layer on its side of the pinned boundary, a row's over the Row Headings in the painted slice's coordinates. The C# core's HeadingMarkStyles is a static class; the Script Core's paint/heading-mark-styles.ts has its functions, Column under the name columnMark and Row under rowMark. The column cases run on four columns 100, 80, 120 and 90 px wide, the first pinned, in a 400 px Viewport: column edges at 0, 100, 180, 300 and 390.
subject: HeadingMarkStyles

cases.name: ADR-0008 (2026-10-13): a run of scrollable columns is marked in the scrollable layer, over the band's last tier, and not in the pinned one
ADR-0008 (2026-10-13) / ADR-0004: a run across the pinned boundary is cut there, its pinned part in the pinned layer and the rest in the scrollable one
ADR-0008 (2026-10-13): a run of Pinned Columns alone leaves the scrollable layer empty
ADR-0008 (2026-10-13): a run past the last column is marked in neither layer
ADR-0008 (2026-10-13): a run of rows is marked over the Row Headings at its place in the painted slice
ADR-0008 (2026-10-13) / ADR-0053: a run of a million rows is cut to the painted rows, one row beyond each end
ADR-0053: a run ending on the row above the painted slice keeps that row; a run wholly outside it is not marked
